subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: For successful runs that retain a recovered or false tool error, should the product suppress the user-facing warning, render it after the final answer, or expose it only through diagnostics?
rationale: The report and prior review establish a remaining warning-policy question, while the exact trigger is not yet confirmed. Choosing visible warning semantics requires maintainer intent rather than an automated repair guess.

options.title: Verify and narrow the warning policy
options.body: Inspect the retained trajectories and current delivery path, then choose the least noisy presentation for a confirmed recovered-warning condition.

options.title: Close after confirmed full fix
options.body: Close only if current source and a real Feishu check show both the warning-first ordering and false/recovered warning behavior no longer occur.

recommendation.title: Verify and narrow the warning policy
recommendation.body: Inspect the retained trajectories and current delivery path, then choose the least noisy presentation for a confirmed recovered-warning condition.
